title: No Helmets Allowed
description: Bans helmets from being used in your world, and refunds the materials.
body:
# No Helmets:

This datapack bans helmets and refunds the materials used to either craft, or if you find a helmet in a loot chest, it will automatically be turned into the material used usually used to craft the item.



For Example, if you were to find an Iron Helmet in a chest, that helmet will be automatically turned into 5 iron ingots.



  _This datapack is aimed towards Last Life, and Third Life servers allowing the owners to restrict what players can use._





If you experience bugs with this datapack, please join my discord.
